detail.title: WAKE Architectural Model and Governance Self-Study
detail.summary: WAKE implements a 'Governance-as-Code' model, separating proposal generation (AI actor) from validation (Governance layer). The AI acts as an untrusted proposal engine, while the Governance layer serves as the immutable state manager, mirroring principles of secure, deterministic systems design. This structure ensures that no matter how complex the AI reasoning becomes, it cannot circumvent the underlying validation rules defined for research integrity and state updates.
detail.reason: The architecture is fundamental to WAKE's operation and explains how it maintains consistency across cycles.
